# 00000001633

**HA-03 ★** — source: 40_同调代数II.md

**English.** Definition: A silting-discrete algebra is one all of whose interval siltings are generated by finitely many atoms. Conjecture: Among tame algebras, exactly those quotients without directed 3-cycle nilpotent chains are silting-discrete; the criterion is purely combinatorial: the quiver contains a chordless cycle if and only if the algebra is not silting-discrete.

**中文。** 定义：silting-离散代数指其一切区间 silting 均由有限原子生成的代数。猜想：温和(tame)代数中 silting-离散者恰为不含有向 3-循环幂零链的商代数;判据为纯组合:箭图含无弦循环 ⟺ 非 silting-离散。
